title: Nagadevathe
desc: Naganna, a worshipper of the snake goddess, vows celibacy in her honour, but is seduced by a dancer. When he dies from a snake bite, his brother starts to despise the deity.

title: Atte Maneya Dari
desc: The grandson of a rich businessman promises to reunite him with his estranged daughter and enters their home in disguise. However, he has to deal with several challenges to keep his promise.

title: Amrithadhare
desc: Puru and Amritha are a married couple deeply in love with each other. However, they face challenges as they try to balance their conflicting desires in their marriage.

title: Salaar
desc: Just when the prince of Khansaar is about to rise to the throne, a plan of overthrowing him is exercised and only one man can help him retrieve power.

title: Gowramma
desc: Venky, a boy from a small town, comes to the city in pursuit of education. His father wants him to do a productive job and sends him to the city to get a job at a friend's place.
